files.use: No longer used by Nutrition since 2026-11-19 (replaced by ASHA's own food model, now models/asha-food-dinov2s-66-int8.onnx); kept for older cached pages.

files.source: Built by ASHA: DINOv2-small (Meta, https://huggingface.co/facebook/dinov2-small) as the int8 dynamically quantised ONNX from https://huggingface.co/Xenova/dinov2-small (onnx/model_quantized.onnx), with ASHA's input normalisation, [CLS, mean patch] pooling and a logistic-regression head trained on Open Images V7 food photos, BD-Food33 and Bangladeshi Street Food photos added to the graph. Scripts: scripts/public-data-validation/nutrition/ (dino_feats.py, bd_train.py, dino_export.py)
files.license: Backbone Apache-2.0; training images: Open Images V7 (CC BY 2.0 images, CC BY 4.0 labels), BD-Food33 (CC0), Bangladeshi Street Food (CC BY 4.0)
files.use: Nutrition: on-device food recognition (65 foods incl. 31 Bangladeshi dishes + not food), experimental, always confirmed by the person. Replaced models/asha-food-66-int8.onnx (EfficientNetV2-B0) on 2026-11-26.
